identity.title: Control Center Portfolio / Risk / Runtime Operations Read Model
identity.objective: Add one bounded read-only /ops Control Center workspace that projects canonical StrategyLifecycle portfolio authority, budget reservations and canonical portfolio capacity through one new GET endpoint, while composing the existing sanitized gateway status/audit and simulated paper summary/risk APIs without changing their canonical owners or inventing current account, host, network, Gate-C, EXEC-FEAS, incident, execution or live truth.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-CC-OPS-01. The single /api/ops/portfolio route, operator_cockpit_ops.py projection, /ops workspace, OPS query keys/stories and OPS contract/status/package disappear. Existing StrategyLifecycle, paper, gateway, research, dependency, workflow, credential, deployment and live state are not migrated or changed.
